interpretation_and_limits: The 25 previously identified points outside the SIG-GR 2026 canton union are also outside the ACT 2026 canton union and ACT national polygon in this point comparison.

The ACT comparison adds five further LUX-only points that were inside a SIG-GR canton but outside the ACT canton union and ACT national outline. Thus the two contemporary representations differ in both extent and membership for this package.

All 26 foreign-contact points fall inside ACT canton and national polygons. This point-in-polygon result does not resolve source attribution, international boundary status, condominium treatment, rights, or a legal territorial claim.

The ACT dataset is a current PCN-derived representation; its refresh date is not a declared observation date, temporal coverage, legal adjudication, or accuracy statement. It does not establish that the 2017 GeoBoundaries layer was adopted, superseded, obsolete, or wrong.

The ACT national outline and its cantons are generalized administrative datasets. The discrepancy warrants retaining the exact groups and asking a bounded source-applicability question; it is not itself proof of territorial transfer or a per-key causal explanation.

The distinct Belgian transfer target remains stopped after the recorded failed/uncertain attempt and ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; no retry, alternate route, or transfer occurred. See inventory/lux-belgian-download-attempt.json and inventory/lux-active-primary-source-vintage-evidence.json.
